reason: The os.Exit entry point is exercised by the installed command subprocess; exitCode and run are fully covered in-process. Child profiles are not merged into this profile.

The emergency stderr write has no injectable sink; closing process-wide stderr would interfere with parallel tests. Real child failure diagnostics and replay errors are asserted separately.
The TestMain parent branch runs in compiled child fixtures; argument forwarding, safe replay and leak rejection are asserted by TestPackageGuard.

encoding/json.Decoder.Token reports malformed JSON as an error before this delimiter fallback; only object and array opening delimiters reach the switch.

os.Executable cannot be made to fail portably inside an already running Go test binary; start failures and unavailable helpers are tested through the actual supervisor.

Cancellation must arrive between the preceding context check and entry into LogValue resolution; tests assert cancellation caused by LogValue and by scanners without relying on scheduler timing.

Closing a regular file that was only read does not fail on the supported platforms; the branch reports such a failure instead of ignoring it.
